paragraphs: OnStrategy describes itself as a consulting firm and software provider focused on strategic planning, AI, and organizational performance. The services side covers building strategic plans and OKRs, with onsite facilitation, over a stated 25+ years of building strategic plans. The software side is described as strategic planning software for aligning a team, designing a strategy, executing with clarity, and engaging a board of directors.

A third line of work is AI strategy and roadmap services, described as creating a roadmap of prioritized AI opportunities for organizations. The about page states that the company is both a strategic services firm and a software company rather than one or the other. That page also states nearly two decades in strategic planning services and facilitation.

The customers page lists case studies for Washoe County, City and County of San Francisco, and County of San Bernardino. Other case studies on that page name Patagonia, Make-A-Wish, and Ohio University Credit Union. The homepage addresses leaders who need a strategic plan, an AI strategy and roadmap, or support with implementation.

quote.text: We’re not just a strategic services firm. We’re not just a software company. We’re both.
